# Independent proactive visual QA — issue #64

Issue: [Establish the supported browser media capability and timing evidence](https://github.com/dystrophyless/dubbed.ai/issues/64). Dedicated reviewer: **GPT-6.1 Sol, High**. Review date: 2026-10-25. Review only; no product/specification/Git/GitHub changes or acceptance/status decisions.

## Verdict and scope

The accepted investigation is carefully bounded and substantially honest. Its evidence does **not** establish a generally supported-browser list, physical phone behavior, production media conversion/storage, or synchronized-capture timing tolerances. Those exclusions are explicit, so unavailable physical devices and unrun server checks are not themselves implementation defects. The four frozen evidence artifacts checked in this review exactly match the hashes in the issue completion record.

Fresh representative capability-failure inspection found **one MEDIUM consuming-UI defect**, plus **two LOW evidence/design findings**. No HIGH finding was confirmed. The UI defect is a downstream consequence of capability handling; this review does not replace the separate microphone-screen owner's review or claim to re-accept that issue. Root aggregation should deduplicate it if another report independently observes the same error mapping.

#64 has no standalone user interface. Its job is to give upload, microphone, recording and result owners trustworthy distinctions between supported operations, unavailable browser capabilities, unexecuted checks and server-only facts. The representative screen here is the microphone check because it exposes both missing-API and live-track-without-recorder combinations without invoking paid processing or physical hardware.

## Snapshot, commands and provenance

- Code baseline: `9d286621177200fdb5f61ef963d0b6818ae76774`. `git status --short -- frontend` returned empty. Existing dirty/untracked documentation, skills and other reviewers' evidence were preserved. This reviewer wrote only `issue-64/`.
- Issue contract: `../contracts/issue-64.md`, fetched by the root on 2026-10-25; closed, zero discussion comments. The earlier report's matrix dates to 2026-10-23 at revision `2f70ac94d059585f9608df39efbc96be555c3f98`; it is historical evidence, not a new measurement.
- Local Vite: frontend cwd, `npm.cmd run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4364 --strictPort`, mock mode. Browser procedure: `node _docs/evidence/proactive-visual-qa-2026-10-25/issue-64/capture.cjs`. Integrity/source audit: `node .../issue-64/audit.cjs`.
- Fresh browser: cached Playwright Chromium **156.0.8078.4**, Windows x64, loopback HTTP. `evidence-audit.json` records exact OS/Node/source hashes. Separate contexts at EN 1440×900, EN 1440×700, RU 390×844 and EN 390×844; DPR 1. Fake device/fake permission UI flags and `--mute-audio`; every media element is muted with volume 0. No physical microphone/speaker use.
- Actual mock registration via UI in each isolated context, using unique synthetic `example.test` addresses and the visibly disclosed mock verification code. Registration and locale setup used the visible desktop header before switching the same context to its target viewport; no product storage was seeded or backend response fabricated.
- Eight fresh screenshots, all visually opened with `view_image`. Screenshots are **full-page**, so image height is not a claim that the entire page fits above the viewport fold. Actual viewport and control positions are in `metrics.json`. `screenshot-manifest.json` lists every file and fault injection.
- First capture attempt stopped when the phone's hidden desktop language selector was targeted. Its partial metrics/log are retained as `metrics-first-attempt.json` and `capture-first-attempt.log`; the corrected completed run produced eight states and zero page errors. This was an automation limitation, not a product defect.

## Findings

### QA-64-01 — MEDIUM — Missing recording capability is presented as a reconnectable failure

**Class:** confirmed implementation defect in a consuming UI, demonstrated as #64's capability distinction consequence. **Affected contract:** #64 AC-01/03 capability/failure distinction; microphone local-test error presentation. **Evidence status:** confirmed with explicit capability fault injection, not a claim that real Safari or a particular phone has this API combination.

**Reproduce:** register in the local mock UI, open `/microphone?origin=new`, leave the native fake microphone available, make `globalThis.MediaRecorder` unavailable, allow microphone access, then click Record test / Записать тест. The actual browser-media service returns `unsupported` before any recorder starts. The screen shows the live connection and an enabled Record test button, then: “The browser could not finish the local microphone test. Reconnect and try again.” RU gives the same reconnect instruction. Continue to New Dub remains available; the optional test is correctly not treated as a speech-quality gate.

**Expected versus actual:** a capability error should say local recording is unavailable in this browser and provide a recovery consistent with that fact. Reconnecting the already-live input cannot install MediaRecorder. The screen collapses every non-ok test result into one boolean and loses the service's useful unsupported distinction. This invites repeat reconnect/test cycles and makes a stable limitation look transient.

**Source:** `frontend/src/services/browser-media.ts:340–345` returns the specific unsupported result; `frontend/src/features/microphone/MicrophoneScreen.tsx:284–286` discards its category; copy at lines41 and78 supplies the misleading recovery. The investigation report already distinguishes live/API availability and explicitly does not certify every browser combination.

**Recommendation:** preserve the error category in the test UI and show a specific localized recording-unavailable explanation. Keep optional-test readiness policy separate; this finding does not authorize changing Continue gating or selecting a supported-browser policy. Next validation: missing MediaRecorder, constructor failure, and a genuinely recoverable device error should produce distinct honest next steps, in EN/RU; verify no capture starts in the unavailable case.

![EN desktop: live track but recorder unavailable](evidence/recorder-unavailable-en-desktop.png)

![RU phone: unavailable recorder produces reconnect instruction](evidence/recorder-unavailable-ru-phone.png)

### QA-64-02 — LOW — Frozen unresolved-decision handoff needs a current reconciliation note

**Class:** evidence maintenance gap, not a defect in the original 2026-10-23 observation. **Affected contract:** #64 AC-04 exact OPEN/task/next-decision handoff. **Evidence status:** confirmed document drift.

The accepted investigation report, `media/investigation-report.md:84`, says the product choice for a source shorter than1.0s is still open and instructs consumers not to infer reject-versus-draft policy. Current Flow06 explicitly resolves it: `_docs/frontend-flows/06-new-dub.md:670` AC-F06-02B rejects originals below1.000s before source/project commit and admits exactly1.000s; line803 narrows OPEN-F06-T02 to technical selection mechanics. Readers following the old report as the current handoff can ask for an already-settled decision or incorrectly defer a validation case.

**Recommendation:** add a dated current evidence-index/addendum pointing from the immutable report to AC-F06-02B and the remaining technical proofs. Preserve frozen report bytes and acceptance hashes. Next validation: current handoff references distinguish resolved product policy from still-unmeasured implementation/media facts. No screenshot can establish this documentary mismatch; the proof is the cited source pair plus hashes in `evidence-audit.json`.

### QA-64-03 — LOW — Compact desktop retry/capture actions are weak for this hands-on recovery task

**Class:** requirement/design flaw / optional usability improvement; **not** a confirmed accessibility violation or reference mismatch. **Affected state:** representative media capability recovery controls consuming #64 facts. **Evidence status:** measured geometry plus visual interpretation.

After Mabry loads, Refresh devices measures **24px / 12px text**, Connect selected microphone and Record test **28px / 13px**, Continue **32px / 13px**. Connect and Record test stretch across roughly670px of the desktop panel while remaining only28px high, giving these central troubleshooting actions the visual weight of thin secondary strips. This is especially noticeable beside40px input selection and16px body labels. It follows the adopted compact source values, but the source's generic density decision is a poor fit for reconnecting/changing devices and repeatedly starting tests while attending to audio equipment.

**Recommendation:** evaluate a scoped desktop ergonomic adaptation for the connection/test actions, such as a taller40–44px minimum and more readable label role, while retaining Mabry, neutral hierarchy, source radius/state treatment and48px phone controls. Keep Refresh devices visually subordinate. Do not change the design system globally from this observation. Next validation: compare the affected actions at1440×700 with actual pointer/keyboard use and repeated device/test workflows; measure misses and task clarity. No performance or WCAG failure is claimed.

**Source/reference:** `_docs/frontend-flows/design-tokens.md:88–90`; adopted BTN Clean Markdown lines289–376 and matching Light `01-initial.png` were read/opened. Source md28/sm24/lg32, radius6,13/20 or12/16 labels and dark/white-secondary treatment are recognizable. Mabry and phone48px are explicit adaptations, not source mismatch.

![Desktop short viewport: very wide compact test/connect actions](evidence/recorder-unavailable-en-short.png)

![Phone adaptation: EN 48px controls](evidence/recorder-unavailable-en-phone.png)

## What works and remaining evidence

The report's skepticism is appropriate: it does not turn WebKit's Windows user agent into iOS proof, a silence-stream blob into measured silence, or raw timing into an accepted synchronization SLA. It records Firefox's incomplete playback separately from audio-track facts, retains noData versus valid-silence distinctions, and does not invent server conversion or refunds. Fresh unsupported-microphone presentation is explicit, localized and blocks continuing without an input. The representative screens retain quiet hierarchy, loaded Mabry, visible text states and full phone targets. All screenshots were opened individually; there is no screenshot-only timing, privacy/security, speaker-quality or durable-storage claim.

Coverage is deliberately bounded. No fresh Firefox/WebKit playback matrix, real Chrome/Edge/Safari device certification, MOV/WebM ingestion,250MB/10min boundary, physical microphone/speaker/BT, screen lock/background, synchronized reference/capture latency, phone keyboard, screen reader, native200% zoom,767/768 boundary, forced colors, server conversion/storage or real processing was executed. RU desktop was not captured; EN desktop/short and both EN/RU phone were covered. This review did not run the full suite or re-review recording/upload/result issues. Existing matrix/timing artifacts were inspected and hash-verified, not rerun. Full-page images do not establish above-fold access at the short viewport. Initial hidden-selector automation failure is preserved and superseded by the completed run, not concealed.

Raw evidence: [metrics](metrics.json), [manifest](screenshot-manifest.json), [capture log](capture.log), [source/hash audit](evidence-audit.json), [capture script](capture.cjs), [audit script](audit.cjs).
